title: Open extension compositor respects strict scalar extension
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, an algebra map $i:E\to F$, and their integer rings $A,B$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the derived categories of strict constant-coefficient module towers, the functors $G_H,J_H,R_H$, and their specified compositors [def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows], [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations], [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]. Let $T_W$ be finite scalar extension, $h_f$ the inverse of strictScalarPull, $b_f$ the openTensor map, and $a_f$ the proper scalar mate [def-pur-constant-scalar-tower-mates], [lem-pur-compact-support-strict-scalar-mate]. For open immersions $f:X\hookrightarrow Y$, $g:Y\hookrightarrow Z$ and $M\in D(\mathrm{Tow}(A_X))$, $T_Z(jComp_A);b_{gf}=b_gJ_{f,A};J_{g,B}(b_f);jComp_B$. No properness, quasi-compactness, constructibility or finite-origin hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Use openTensor_ordinary and ordinaryOpenTensor_isIso to make the specified openTensor into an isomorphism. Its inverse is the mate, under the two open adjunctions, of strictScalarPull.hom: cancel the openTensor factor in strictScalarOpenUnit and apply mateEquiv_eq_of_unit.
Cancel the inverse strict scalar pullback comparisons in strictScalarPullComposition to obtain its hom version. This is the horizontal pasting equation for the mates of the inverse open maps.

The definition of jComp as leftAdjointCompIso gives its conjugate gComp.hom; the inverse has conjugate gComp.inv. Apply injectivity of mateEquiv to the inverse open comparison and the vertically pasted successive inverse open comparisons, whiskered with jComp.hom and jComp.inv. The Mathlib mateEquiv_hcomp and the two conjugate-whiskering identities reduce their equality to the preceding hom pullback equation, followed by cancellation of gComp.hom and gComp.inv.

Evaluate the equality of inverse natural transformations at M. Cancel the inverse composite open scalar comparison and use functoriality and the hom/inv identities to obtain exactly the displayed forward compositor equation.

lean.statement:
theorem strictScalarOpenComposition {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion g]
    (M : Derived (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) X) :
    (T l E F i Z).map
        ((jComp (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) f g).hom.app M) ≫
        (openTensor l E F i (f ≫ g)).app M =
      (openTensor l E F i g).app
          ((J (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) f).obj M) ≫
        (J (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F)) g).map
          ((openTensor l E F i f).app M) ≫
        (jComp (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F)) f g).hom.app
          ((T l E F i X).obj M)
lean.note: The section parameters l, E, F, i and their instances occur above the theorem in the module; this field reproduces its written signature verbatim.
